title: VTC Vetting — Vetters Profile — payload
description: A vetter publishes, replaces or unlists their vetter profile with their community: the languages, coarse location, methods, documentation and events an applicant looking for a vetter can filter on. The payload is the whole profile and replaces whatever the community held. `listed: false` keeps the profile but removes it from vtc/vetting/vetters/list.

listed.description: Whether the profile appears in vtc/vetting/vetters/list. `false` keeps it stored and hidden.

languages.description: BCP 47 tags of the languages the vetter can hold a session in, most preferred first. May be empty.

events.description: Events the vetter will attend and vet at. May be empty. Events that have ended stay stored but are not listed.

Response.title: VTC Vetting — Vetters Profile — response payload

updatedAt.description: When the community stored this profile. vtc/vetting/vetters/list returns the same value.
